project: Jingzhang Time Rights / 京张时权
purpose: Audit reusable evidence already present in merged submissions before introducing any value into the Time Rights model.
rules: Never treat another submission's synthetic or illustrative outputs as observed Haidian data.
Prefer original official/public sources over copying another participant's derived asset.
OSM-derived geometry may be reconstructed from OSM with ODbL attribution; repository files are used as cross-checks and discovery leads unless their reuse license explicitly permits republication.
Design conclusions, scenario claims and visual assets from other submissions are not reused as our design output.
Every imported baseline receives source_class, reuse_mode and confidence fields before it can enter analysis.

evidence_classes.A: official_public fact or regulation; may support formal factual claims within stated scope
evidence_classes.B: OSM/public mapped existing condition; usable as analytical background with attribution, not legal redline
evidence_classes.C: repository method/code structure; reusable only as method inspiration or independently reimplemented workflow
evidence_classes.D: synthetic/illustrative simulation; never a local baseline; usable only for sensitivity/proof-of-method
evidence_classes.E: agent-generated design geometry/claim; not a factual baseline

audited_assets.observed: Existing-condition features explicitly marked source_type=osm include 学院路、西土城路、知春路、成府路、清华东路、北四环西路、大钟寺东路.
audited_assets.reuse_mode: source-discovery-and-cross-check; reconstruct from OSM rather than republish participant asset
audited_assets.limitations: OSM-level approximation; not a road redline, survey or engineering alignment.

audited_assets.observed: Detailed coordinate chains cite alignment_basis=OSM_named_way and source_ref=OSM-20260810, but features are packaged as agent-generated design proposals.
audited_assets.reuse_mode: use named-way and OSM-source hints only; do not copy design route geometry into our baseline
audited_assets.limitations: Road widths and official redlines remain unknown.

audited_assets.observed: The audit points to official Beijing/Haidian sources for Phase I opening and Phase II planned corridor facts, while clearly separating planned counts from current operating status.
audited_assets.reuse_mode: follow original official source URLs and independently cite/restate facts; do not copy participant inference layer
audited_assets.limitations: Planned entrances, links and activity areas are not automatically current/open/accessible.

audited_assets.observed: File self-identifies as regional_population_scale_synthetic_two_peak_flow_not_local_OD; OD assignment and modal parameters are synthetic.

audited_assets.limitations: Mode demand, capacity and performance readouts are illustrative.
